links.outcome: Multi-policy safety screening accuracy of the local Tier-1 classifier
links.effect: Frozen local encoders matched cloud models on structured PHI detection (>= 98.3% accuracy in <= 23.5 ms) but degraded markedly on semantic safety and symmetric-blocklist prompts. End-to-end fine-tuning of a 335M-parameter BGE-Large classifier reached 98.90% out-of-fold accuracy, 97.8%-98.2% recall and a 0.0%-0.4% over-refusal rate. The zero-shot cloud LLM judge scored 99.20% (exact McNemar p = 0.648).
links.tradeoff: The fine-tuned classifier took 39.0 ms per query, longer than the frozen encoders' <= 23.5 ms on PHI detection. Residual errors remained on reading-level checks (93.3%-95.3% recall).
links.quote: However, end-to-end representation fine-tuning closes the multi-policy accuracy gap: a fine-tuned 335M-parameter BGE-Large classifier achieves 98.90% out-of-fold accuracy versus 99.20% for a zero-shot cloud LLM judge (exact McNemar p = 0.648, zero shared errors), 97.8%-98.2% recall, and a 0.0%-0.4% over-refusal rate in 39.0 ms (>14x faster than cloud LLM evaluation on our benchmark host).

design_hint: tiered safety screening with local classifier and cloud LLM judge escalation (output filters/guardrails)
